channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cam Reddish | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cam Reddish from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Cam Reddish
item.description:
Darvin Ham on Cam Reddish (sore adductor):

“His MRI came back pretty much clean … not as severe as we were in fear of. It will be a day-to-day thing that we’ll manage.”

Darvin Ham on Cam Reddish, Nov 22, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: LeBron James on Cam Reddish
item.description:
“I make the right play every single time. And the game ball goes to Cam Reddish for sure.”

LeBron James on Cam Reddish, Nov 11, 2023. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Cam Reddish
item.description:
“To all the naysayers and basketball savants that don't know nothing about basketball and telling me I should've shot that shot in Miami instead of passing to Cam Reddish, well I did the same thing tonight because I trust my teammates,”

LeBron James on Cam Reddish, Nov 11, 2023. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Cam Reddish
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Thibs on Cam Reddish:

“He’s played very well. I’m happy for him. It was one of those trades that I think was good for both teams.”

Tom Thibodeau on Cam Reddish, Mar 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Trae Young on Cam Reddish
item.description:
Trae Young on Cam Reddish returning to action:

“To be honest that was the only positive thing tonight. Getting to see Cam back and getting to see him on the court was awesome, and he played great. He was aggressive. So that was probably one of, if our only bright spot tonight.”

Trae Young on Cam Reddish, Jun 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.
